Provider integration boundaries and build fragments

disposition: DAC-SE1 codec-token speech-enhancement feasibility blocker; only one census sentence and two source-reported links name the candidate. The immutable upstream revision, license text, checkpoint and tokenizer assets, CUDA-class runtime, rights-cleared inputs and any output are absent, so there is no implementation, execution or result.

requirement_rows.evidence: The synthetic envelope copies caller bytes exactly and labels an identity control, but no DAC-SE1 candidate, noise injection or established enhancement baseline is executed.
requirement_rows.requirement: Identity/noisy control plus an established task-matched baseline.

requirement_rows.evidence: No rights-cleared clean-reference cohort, independent scorer or candidate output exists; no paired metric is computed.
requirement_rows.requirement: Paired SI-SDR and STOI where permitted clean references exist.

requirement_rows.evidence: Only synthetic finite/peak breath checks on copied bytes exist; no clean-speech preservation result and no candidate output validity result is available.
requirement_rows.requirement: Clean-speech preservation, peaks and invalid outputs.

requirement_rows.evidence: The exact CUDA-class runtime, codec-token toolchain, chunking recipe and device are absent; no alignment, state, memory or availability timing was measured.
requirement_rows.requirement: Alignment, state, memory and measured content/availability timing for the exact runtime.

requirement_rows.evidence: No unpaired speech, predictive screen or listening protocol and result exists.
requirement_rows.requirement: Separately labeled predictive screen or authorized listening for unpaired speech.

requirement_rows.evidence: No real or synthetic speech condition is scored; the envelope uses one deterministic placeholder frame that is not audio evidence.
requirement_rows.requirement: Quiet and active speech, idle noise, low SNR and onset/offset condition coverage.

requirement_rows.evidence: The report keeps synthetic envelope, admission schema, historical census prose and missing real results in distinct sections; no category is pooled with another.
requirement_rows.requirement: Separate paired, unpaired, synthetic, human and source-reported evidence.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply the exact upstream repository and an immutable commit or release revision, the complete source snapshot, the MIT license text and notices, and a source-to-artifact map. No download is permitted inside this package.
exact_blockers.statement: Only the source-reported repository URL https://github.com/ETH-DISCO/DAC-SE1 is recorded. No immutable commit or release revision, source file, code license text, COPYING/NOTICE or model-card snapshot is staged, and no DAC-SE1 source tree is present at any probed path.

exact_blockers.required_action: Stage the complete checkpoint, tokenizer, vocoder and config asset set with exact file names, immutable revision, byte counts and matching SHA-256 values, plus an artifact-specific terms review. No weight may be downloaded, reconstructed or inferred here.
exact_blockers.statement: The census reports a released checkpoint of 1.84 GB at https://huggingface.co/disco-eth/DAC-SE1 but records no file names, immutable revision, byte counts or SHA-256 values, and does not enumerate the tokenizer, vocoder or inference-config files. No checkpoint or tokenizer byte is present at any probed path.

exact_blockers.required_action: Provide a locked offline CUDA-class runtime with wheel names, versions, byte counts, SHA-256 values and install location, plus the exact device, dtype, chunk size, seed, context and padding recipe used for the reference.
exact_blockers.statement: No CUDA-class runtime is installed or pinned. The probed interpreter exposes no torch, torchaudio or dac module, no environment or wheel lock exists, and no device, dtype, chunk size, seed, context or padding recipe is recorded.

exact_blockers.required_action: Provide the license and notice text, reviewed code, weight, training-data and tokenizer-toolchain terms, and a digest-pinned rights-cleared caller input set with acquisition, evaluation, derived-output and redistribution decisions.
exact_blockers.statement: MIT is declared in the census for code and checkpoint, but no license text, notice, model-card, weight-specific term, training-data statement, codec/tokenizer lineage or rights-cleared caller input is staged or reviewed.

exact_blockers.required_action: After the source, checkpoint, runtime and rights gates clear, run offline with deterministic settings and no network; record per-item hashes, finite and length-preserving checks, exact repeats, identity/noisy controls, paired SI-SDR/STOI, preservation, peaks, alignment, state, memory and timing.
exact_blockers.statement: No DAC-SE1 inference or enhancement result is reproduced. Without source, checkpoint, tokenizer, runtime and inputs there is no identity/noisy control, candidate output, paired SI-SDR/STOI, clean-speech preservation, finite/length check, alignment, state, memory or content/availability timing.

exact_blockers.required_action: Measure mode and platform separately, record device timing and resources, run authorized listening or a labeled predictive screen, then open a separate versioned OFF-by-default provider intake with clean-install proof and independent exact-head review.
exact_blockers.statement: No provider, descriptor, registry entry, default selection, mode/platform measurement, listening test, benchmark result or release claim exists. The package is task-local evidence only.

mode_platform_rows.evidence: The census says published inference uses CUDA but records no runtime, chunk configuration, hardware or whole-clip measurement; nothing was run.
The census says an MPS route would be a separate unvalidated backend and the tokenizer/toolchain must be verified; no MPS result exists.
The census says the candidate is not runnable on the current CPU-only worker as published; no CPU fallback was attempted or measured.

non_claims: No DAC-SE1 source, repository snapshot, checkpoint, tokenizer, vocoder, config or generation implementation is present, loaded, deserialized or reconstructed.
No torch, torchaudio, dac package, CUDA runtime or model dependency is imported, installed, linked or executed.
No real audio, corpus, manifest payload or model output is read or produced.
No DAC-SE1 inference, quality, fidelity, parity, speed, resource, listening, device or benchmark result is reproduced or claimed.
The synthetic envelope and admission control are protocol plumbing only; they are not a model, a tokenizer, a checkpoint, a quality result or a qualification.
No provider, descriptor, registry, default, public ABI, shared build or CI change exists.
The census sentence and its two links are source-reported context only and are not promoted to measured evidence.

reopening_conditions: Pin the exact upstream source revision, MIT license and notice.
Stage the checkpoint, tokenizer, vocoder and config files with per-file byte counts and SHA-256 values.
Provide a locked offline CUDA-class runtime and the exact generation configuration.
Provide rights-cleared inputs and checkpoint/tokenizer training-data terms.
Reproduce deterministic offline runs and complete the Enhancement profile, including controls and preservation.
Measure mode and platform separately, complete listening or a labeled predictive screen, then open a separate OFF-by-default intake and independent review.

required_artifacts.requirement: The pinned candidate census, structured inventory record, Enhancement acceptance profile, SDK delivery plan and unchanged v0 contract boundary.
The exact ETH-DISCO/DAC-SE1 source tree at an immutable commit or release revision, with the code license text, COPYING/NOTICE and model-card/README text.
The released DAC-SE1 checkpoint plus every required tokenizer, vocoder and inference-config file, with exact file names, immutable revision, byte counts and SHA-256 values.
A locked offline CUDA-class Python/PyTorch runtime with wheel names, versions, byte counts, SHA-256 values and install location, plus device, dtype, chunk size and generation settings.

A digest-pinned caller-owned input set with corpus, acquisition, evaluation, derived-output and redistribution decisions, plus checkpoint training-data terms, codec/tokenizer lineage and an attribution record.

A deterministic offline run in the exact runtime with per-item input/output hashes, finite and length-preserving checks, exact repeats, peak/RSS values, identity/noisy controls, paired SI-SDR/STOI, preservation, alignment, state, memory and content/availability timing.

A separate versioned OFF-by-default developer tool or provider intake with clean-install proof, empty defaults, no registry or shared-build change, separate mode/platform measurements and independent exact-head review after every other gate clears.

required_results: Exact upstream URL, immutable revision, source snapshot, MIT license and notice for DAC-SE1.
Complete checkpoint, tokenizer, vocoder and config manifest with file names, revisions, byte counts and SHA-256.
Locked offline CUDA-class runtime with wheel digests, install location and clean-room import digest.
Exact device, dtype, chunk size, seed, context and padding recipe.
Rights-cleared, digest-pinned caller inputs and checkpoint/tokenizer training-data terms.
Deterministic reproduced runs with finite/length-preserving outputs and exact repeats.
Identity/noisy controls, task-matched baseline, paired SI-SDR/STOI and clean-speech preservation.
Alignment, state, memory and content/availability timing for the exact runtime.
Separate mode/platform timing, authorized listening and independent provider intake review.
